verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Codegen can 'improve documentation' as part of coding tasks and interact with repos via GitHub App, but there is no evidence of a dedicated feature to generate and query documentation for any public or private repository (e.g., a docs Q&A/wiki-style interface). Missing for 10: any mention of auto-generated repo documentation, a query/search interface over that documentation, or support for arbitrary public/private repos beyond connected ones.
